svg.title: ShadowsLunarfox/Custom-Folder-For-Unity
svg.desc: A extension customize the unity project tab A Unity Editor tool for customizing folders in the Project window. It lets you assign custom colors, backgrounds, name colors, and icons so large Unity projects are easier to browse, organize, and recognize. C#; 6 stars; 0 forks.

g.font-family: Segoe UI, Noto Sans, Arial, sans-serif
